name: Mövenpick Villas & Residences Phu Quoc
short_description: A 408-unit property on Ong Lang Beach with 79 private-pool villas and 329 residences, sharing facilities with the adjacent Mövenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc.
ai_summary: Mövenpick Villas & Residences Phu Quoc sits on Ong Lang Beach on Phu Quoc's west coast, roughly 17-18 km from Phu Quoc International Airport, and shares its beachfront and dining facilities with the neighbouring Mövenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc. The property has 408 units in total: 79 villas with private pools, ranging from one-bedroom to a four-bedroom presidential villa, plus 329 residences and studios with kitchenettes and balconies. Guest reviews are consistently positive about the beachfront setting, spacious rooms, and friendly, professional staff, with the breakfast buffet frequently highlighted, though some reviews note the pool and breakfast areas can feel crowded in peak season and extra dining/spa charges add up.

core_facts.address: Ong Lang Beach, Cua Duong Village, Phu Quoc, Kien Giang Province, Vietnam

pros: 408 units total: 79 private-pool villas (1- to 4-bedroom) plus 329 residences and studios

research_watchouts: Some guests report the breakfast area and pools get busy at peak times, affecting the otherwise-quiet feel

faqs.question: How many villas and residences does Mövenpick Villas & Residences Phu Quoc have?
faqs.answer: The property has 408 units in total: 79 villas with private pools, ranging from one-bedroom units up to a four-bedroom presidential villa, plus 329 residences and studios with kitchenettes and balconies. It sits directly on Ong Lang Beach and shares facilities with the adjacent Mövenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc.

faqs.question: How far is Mövenpick Villas & Residences Phu Quoc from the airport?
faqs.answer: It's roughly 18 km, or about a 25-30 minute drive, from Phu Quoc International Airport on the island's west coast at Ong Lang Beach. The resort offers a free airport shuttle service, and Ong Lang's beaches and Phu Quoc's northern attractions are a short drive away.
